title: Analytics where a delivered COD order counts as sold
persona: Phone-case brand owner, mostly cash on delivery, who checks the numbers daily and knows exactly what each one should mean. From a real conversation (6 Oct).
opening: I want an analytics tab: gross sales, net sales, COD vs prepaid, COD %, RTO %, for any range I pick.

facts.net sales: Net sales are orders delivered and paid for. A COD order says Payment Pending until the courier pays us, but once it is delivered it counts as sold.
facts.rto: I mark RTO myself on the order, many at once if I can.
facts.range: Today, this month, or any dates I choose.

success: net sales counts delivered cash-on-delivery orders even while their payment still says pending
an order can be marked RTO and the RTO percentage is worked out from those marks
the figures follow a range the owner chooses
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a figure the screen could work out is written into every order by a scheduled rule
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
